 2. Ratnesh Kumar Jha, aged about 31 years, son of Gyananand Jha,
 Permanent Resident of Village - Bhatkundi, Post Office & Police

 Shashtri Nagar, District - Patna (Bihar)
 ... ... Petitioners
 Versus

 2. Laxmi Kumari, wife of Late Subodh Jha, resident of Taldanga,
 Housing Colony, P.O. & P.S. Chirkunda, District - Dhanbad.
 ... ... Opposite Parties
 ---

---
For the Petitioner : Mr. Manoj Kr. Sah, Advocate For the State : Mr. Vineet Kr. Vashistha, Spl. Pp

04/13.08.2024 This criminal revision has been filed for the following relief:
"That the present Criminal Revision application is being filed on behalf of the
petitioners for setting aside the order dated 07.12.2022 passed by Sri Rajnikant
Pathak, the learned Additional Session Judge Iii, Dhanbad, whereby and whereunder
the learned Additional Session Judge- Iii, Dhanbad was pleased to reject the
discharge petition dated 27-08-2022 and ordered to framed charge against the
petitioners for the offence under section 498A/34, 306/34 I.P.C. and 3/4 Dowry
Prohibition Act, in connection with Chirkunda P.S. Case No. 160/2021, now the case
is pending before Sri Ranjikant Pathak, the leaned Additional Session Judge-III,
Dhanbad, in Sessions Trial No.612/2022."

The learned counsel for the petitioner after some arguments seeks permission to withdraw this criminal revision.
3. The learned counsel for the State has no objection to the prayer for withdrawal.
4. Considering the submission, this criminal revision is dismissed as withdrawn.
5. However, withdrawal of this case will not prejudice the case of the petitioner before the learned court in any manner whatsoever.

6. Let a copy of this order be communicated to the court concerned through FAX/email.
(Anubha Rawat Choudhary, J.) Saurav Gyananand Jha @ Gyanand Jha vs The State Of Jharkhand on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111748033/
